fortune_draw_palm.message0: Xiao Liu Ren draw palm diagram
fortune_draw_palm.tooltip: Draw the palm base diagram: finger blocks + six-god names + finger names (white background, orange text)

fortune_god_seg_x.message0: Xiao Liu Ren palace X coordinate palace %1
fortune_god_seg_x.tooltip: X coordinate of the six-god palace on the palm diagram (0-5)

fortune_god_seg_y.message0: Xiao Liu Ren palace Y coordinate palace %1
fortune_god_seg_y.tooltip: Y coordinate of the six-god palace on the palm diagram (0-5)

fortune_hour_index.tooltip: 24-hour clock (0-23) to hour-branch index 0-11: 0=Zi…11=Hai (matches original, floor of h/2)

fortune_light_god.message0: Xiao Liu Ren light up palace %1
fortune_light_god.tooltip: Highlight the given six-god palace (yellow bg, black text); others return to white bg, orange text

fortune_lunar_day.message0: Lunar day (from Gregorian) year %1 month %2 day %3
fortune_lunar_day.tooltip: Gregorian to lunar day (1900-2100), returns 1-30; 0 for out-of-range or invalid dates

fortune_lunar_month.message0: Lunar month (from Gregorian) year %1 month %2 day %3
fortune_lunar_month.tooltip: Gregorian to lunar month (1900-2100), returns 1-12; 0 for out-of-range or invalid dates (leap month returns its ordinal, e.g. leap 6th month = 6)

iching_advice.message0: I Ching category advice index %1 category %2
iching_advice.tooltip: Advice of a hexagram under a category (0 fortune/1 career/2 business/3 fame/4 love/5 decision)

iching_kw_index.message0: I Ching hexagram index from six-line code %1
iching_kw_index.tooltip: Six-line code (upper trigram x8 + lower, counting bottom-up) to hexagram index 0-63

iching_name.tooltip: Name of hexagram index (0-63), e.g. Qian (Heaven)

liuren_hour_name.message0: Xiao Liu Ren hour name index %1
liuren_hour_name.tooltip: Name of hour-branch index (0-11), e.g. Zi (23-01)

liuren_name.message0: Xiao Liu Ren six-god name palace %1

liuren_position.message0: Xiao Liu Ren palace lunar month %1 day %2 hour index %3
liuren_position.tooltip: Month/day/hour triple counting from Daan: 0 Daan, 1 Liulian, 2 Suxi, 3 Chikou, 4 Xiaoji, 5 Kongwang
